svg.title: Zero training data strategy options
svg.desc: Three paths from zero labelled data to a working prototype

g.text: Your constraint: zero labelled data. Three viable paths.
Path A — use COCO pretrained YOLOv8n as-is (zero training required)
Path B — record 30–60 mins of video, label with Roboflow, fine-tune YOLOv8n

svg.text: Act out the violations yourself. You need roughly 200–400 labelled frames per class to fine-tune reliably.

g.text: Path C — transfer from existing hand interaction dataset

svg.text: Existing public datasets you can use as a starting point, then fine-tune on your own 50–100 clips:

g.text: Recommendation: Path A as proof of concept now, Path B for final demo
Get the pipeline working end-to-end with Path A, then swap in the Path B model once trained
